data_objects.name: weather_observations
data_objects.meaning: Timestamped weather observations containing wind, air, barometric, humidity, and visibility fields.
data_objects.notes: The source headers omit measurement units and use abbreviated field names.

variables.name: DATE TIME
variables.meaning: Date and hour of the weather observation.

structure.description: Each row represents an hourly observation keyed and chronologically ordered by DATE TIME.

uncertainties: The location, time zone, instruments, and units are not stated in train.csv.
The intended missing-value convention for the relative-humidity and visibility fields is not documented.
annotation_notes: Abbreviated labels are described conservatively where train.csv does not define their units or collection context.
